info.name: hermiq-exec
info.summary: Hardened, egress-jailed execution worker for Hermiq LLM/agent jobs
info.description:
hermiq-exec — hardened execution worker for Hermiq
A headless ExApp worker that runs Hermiq's heavy/jailed LLM and agent work (document analysis, Claude CLI invocations) inside a network-isolated container. It has no user-facing UI: it registers two Nextcloud TaskProcessing task types (hermiq:doc-analyze, hermiq:agent-exec), polls Nextcloud for tasks Hermiq (PHP) enqueues, executes them under an egress allowlist (Anthropic API + Ollama host only), and reports results back.
See SPECTR-NEXTCLOUD-PLAN.md §6.5 (hydra ADR-050) for the design and the honest isolation-delta note vs. Specter's per-batch container model.
This is a SCAFFOLD: the worker loop, TaskProcessing registration, and Dockerfile are a working skeleton; the egress jail and app registration have not been exercised against a live Nextcloud + AppAPI instance yet.
info.author: Conduction

variable.name: HERMIQ_EXEC_MAX_JOBS
variable.description: Worker exits (for Docker restart) after processing this many tasks, bounding state accumulation from the single long-running container. Default: 200.

variable.name: HERMIQ_EXEC_POLL_INTERVAL
variable.description: Delay between next_task_batch polls when no task is available. Default: 5.

variable.name: HERMIQ_EXEC_POLL_BATCH
variable.description: Number of tasks requested per next_task_batch call. Default: 1.

variable.name: COMPUTE_DEVICE
variable.description: CUDA or ROCM, for local-model passthrough (Ollama/Qwen). Leave empty for CPU/API-only.
